Singapore Airlines Reveals New Long Haul Cabins

Singapore Airlines has revealed its next-generation long-haul cabins.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:58
Instaread

The new cabin products will be progressively introduced from the second half of 2027 on SIA’s 41 retrofitted Airbus A350-900 long-haul and A350-900 ultra-long-range (ULR ) aircraft, and its new Boeing 777-9 fleet.

First Class

Designed by PriestmanGoode, manufactured by Collins Aerospace.

Available on the Boeing 777-9 and Airbus A350-900ULR aircraft.

• Curved sliding doors enhance the sense of privacy and spaciousness for each passenger.

• Premium Poltrona Frau leather upholstery, enhanced seat adjustment options, dedicated storage, and a large table for companion dining or work.

• Fully retractable divider between centre seats for an expansive shared space.

• Individual full-flat beds measure 80 inches in length and 30 inches in width.

• Versatile centre seats that can transform into a two-seater sofa for daytime lounging or the largest double bed in commercial aviation (80 inches long and 60 inches wide).

• Immersive entertainment experience featuring a 32-inch 4K touch screen display with spatial audio.

First Class Fact Sheet

Business Class

Designed by Designworks, manufactured by RECARO Aircraft Seating.

• Available on Boeing 777-9, A350-900 long-haul, and A350-900ULR aircraft.

• Full-grain leather upholstery with embroidery.

• Enhanced seat ergonomics, with coordinated reclining movements and adjustable lumbar and leg support for personalised comfort.

• Full-flat beds measure 79 inches in length and up to 24 inches in width.

• Selected centre seats can be configured as companion beds.

• The table stows away at an angle that creates a generously-sized footwell, giving customers more room to move and reposition their feet comfortably while sleeping.

• Sliding doors and electronically adjustable centre dividers allow customers to tailor their level of privacy and personal space.

• 4K touch screen displays of up to 22 inches, with spatial audio and Bluetooth headphone pairing.

Business Class Fact Sheet

Premium Economy

Designed by Factorydesign, manufactured by Collins Aerospace.

New Premium Economy Class seat will only feature on the Boeing 777-9 with 2-4-2 layout.

• A 40-inch seat pitch, full-grain upholstery, plush cushioning, and adjustable foot and leg rests for added ergonomic comfort and support.

• Convenience features include dedicated personal storage, a cocktail tray for drinks, an adjustable personal reading light, and a holder for hands-free viewing on personal electronic devices.

• Next-generation KrisWorld experience with 4K high-resolution touch screens of up to 16 inches, spatial audio, and Bluetooth headphone pairing.

Premium Economy Class Fact Sheet

Economy Class

Designed by Factorydesign, manufactured by Collins Aerospace.

The new Economy Class seat will be featured only on the Boeing 777-9s. The cabin layout will be 3-4-3, with 31-32 seat pitch.

• Ergonomic cushioning, improved knee and shin clearance, and adjustable headrest for greater comfort throughout the flight.

• Next-generation KrisWorld experience featuring 4K high resolution touchscreen displays, spatial audio, Bluetooth audio pairing, and a secondary display with real-time journey updates.

• USB charging ports to keep customers’ devices charged onboard.

Economy Class Fact Sheet

Images and Fact Sheet: Singapore Airlines
